name: 250. Typesafe images and box (typesafe-images)
description: Typesafe images and box questions. Images are listed once in the request's assets map and placed by reference wherever their key is written: in the state, inside a question's instructions, or in choice, score, and noul criteria. Box answers where something is in an image, and needs Jev 1.14 (jev-preview or jev-1.14.0). Bifrost adds the TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Images header whenever a request carries assets or a box question, so no case here sends it. On /typesafe/v1/systemone the native body reaches Typesafe as sent, as JSON with base64 assets or as multipart with each image in its own file part. On /v1/decisions an image sent by reference is an input_image part with an id and its file base64-encoded in data, or in a multipart request a file part its name points at, its format read from the bytes; a single message holding one input_text part plus such parts is sent as that text for the state, so a structured state stays structured. Typesafe judges the images itself (a GIF is its own 400), Bifrost rejects only what it cannot build the request from (a part no asset names), and other providers receive the assets too and give their own verdict (Azure rejects the field today).
